result.description: Read the summary and nets; report free ends and nets with a single pin.

content.text: Call omnia_inspect with doc_id d1 and include ["summary", "nets"]. Report the part, wire and label counts, then list every net that has a single pin and every pin that is a net of its own (a free end). Do not edit anything.

result.description: Place parts and wire them, following the safe loop of section 13.

content.text: In document d1, place these parts: R1 and R2, Resistor-IEEE-Standard, 10k. Wire these connections: R1 pin 2 to R2 pin 1. First omnia_inspect the document, then omnia_preview the whole batch, read the predicted change, and only then omnia_apply it with the preview_id, the expected_revision and an idempotency_key. Finish with omnia_nets and report the nets that joined.

result.description: The verification protocol of section 13, as instructions.

content.text: Work in this loop: 1. omnia_capabilities. 2. omnia_open or omnia_new, then omnia_inspect. 3. omnia_preview the batch; read the predicted pins and ids. 4. omnia_apply with preview_id, expected_revision and idempotency_key. 5. omnia_nets to check connectivity. 6. omnia_save to a new path; check the response; reopen and compare. Never invent ids, params or symbol names, and never edit the only copy of a file.
